name: m8-end-to-end-model-deadline
title: M8 End-to-End Model Deadline
description: Bound primary and fallback model execution with one monotonic route deadline while preserving cancellation, circuit-breaker, and public gateway contracts.
scope: route-level monotonic deadline; primary/fallback remaining-budget enforcement; cancellation propagation; circuit-breaker timeout accounting; configuration and contract tests
creator: developer
notes: M8 closes the explicit M7 production gap where primary and fallback provider calls have independent timeout budgets. It preserves the ChatModelGateway protocol and records local contract evidence only.
